jobs.title: Senior AI Analyst
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of experience in data analysis, product analytics, or a similar analytical role (senior or lead-level scope) Strong SQL skills with proven experience working with large datasets Proficiency with Python (or similar) for data analysis and automation

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years building modern SaaS web apps, with deep experience in React + TypeScript Strong engineering fundamentals (clean code, scalable UI architecture, thoughtful tradeoffs) High standards for pixel-perfect UI, accessibility, and user experience

jobs.title: Security Researcher
jobs.description: Conduct deep technical research across codebases, architectures, integrations, data flows, permissions, and agentic workflows to identify product security risks that traditional scanners often miss Investigate how AI coding agents, LLM-based workflows, and AI-assisted engineering practices change how security risks are introduced, missed, prioritized, and remediated Translate research into useful outputs such as product recommendations, customer-facing guidance, technical writeups, evaluation ideas, talks, and internal briefs Strong threat modeling judgment using frameworks such as OWASP, STRIDE, or similar Heavy hands-on use of AI coding agents, LLM-based development workflows, or AI-assisted software engineering tools in real-world engineering/research environments Strong application or product security expertise with the ability to reason across code, architecture, product behavior, and business context
